summary: Generated comprehensive kernels no longer call the private KernelPanicTransport bootstrap implementation from user Kernel.cs.
rootCause: The 0.11.13 architecture-specific generator exposed KernelPanicTransport.Initialize() in generated Kernel.cs even though the selected user-kernel compilation surface does not compile that bootstrap helper into the user project.
fixes: Removed KernelPanicTransport.Initialize() from Microkernel, Hybrid and Monolithic generated Kernel.cs sources.
Kept the kernel panic transport in the SDK/bootstrap support where the panic framework configures platform callbacks.
Removed the private transport from PUBLIC-SDK-USAGE.md public-call examples.
Added a verifier preventing private bootstrap transport calls from being emitted into comprehensive user kernels.
